label: copy-phase echoed l input (recall_idx>=3), esp. before outputting p/l/i
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only (99.7% of mass) when the fed-back input token is l, i.e. the model just output an original l. It is essentially silent for recall_idx<=2 and peaks at recall_idx 3-5 (t=10-13), with more mass in long sequences (L=8-9) and less on the final step. Firing is much more likely when the current output is p, l or i (rate 0.8%/0.5%/0.4% vs about 0.1% for most others); the top examples are l followed by p. Even so it fires on only about 5% of copy-phase l inputs at recall_idx>=3, so precision is low. The gating seems to depend on finer sequence context that I could not capture. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on any input other than l (apart from a few p inputs).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=l (+5.84), in_tok=l (+4.24), phase=2 & out_tok=r (+2.81), phase=2 & out_tok=p (+2.65), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+2.48), out_tok=p (+2.48).
